description: This file defines the internal HashRing struct used for consistent hashing of QueueId objects within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for computing responsible queue, retrieving all ring members, and a custom binary search implementation. The struct helps in distribution and load balancing of stream processing across nodes.

classes.name: HashRing
classes.description: Internal readonly struct for managing a ring of QueueIds, used for consistent hashing in streaming.

methods.name: HashRing
methods.description: Constructor that sorts the QueueId array based on their hash codes.

methods.name: GetAllRingMembers
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds in the ring.

methods.name: CalculateResponsible
methods.description: Computes which QueueId is responsible for a given hash code using clockwise traversal.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representing all QueueIds in the ring.
